review_locator: PMCID:PMC7116134, The Lysophosphatidylserines: an Emerging Class of Signalling Lysophospholipid review
primary_title: Structural basis for ligand recognition and signaling of the lysophosphatidylserine receptors GPR34 and GPR174
decision_basis: Primary cryo-EM and mutational/functional data support exact LysoPS-receptor-Gi coupling at the bounded receptor-proximal layer.
limitations_preserved: Preserve LysoPS agonist and receptor-specific representative Gi coupling, emerging ligand-receptor nomenclature, heterologous/reconstituted assay context and no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
